body.p: A hare and a wolverine. A hare and a wolverine are running along the road. The hare runs along the road in front, the old wolverine walks behind. She said: "Hare, where are you going from?" "I've been walking without a road for several days. My feet got tired, my head aches. I do not have any force, I will go back." "Don't go back, you'll get caught, you'll fall into a trap. The human has installed his traps. So go ahead. You will go along a road, you will find something." The road went the other way. The hare went back. He thinks: "I didn't listen to old Wolverine before, but just lived. The wolverine did not teach me." In the evening, the wolverine went home along the road. What is it lying in front? The hare is lying across the road. His eyes are closed, his mouth is open. He fell into a trap. "I said, - thought the wolverine, - the hare did not listen to me. Now it died, I feel sorry for the hare."
